listing.name: Call of Duty 3 (CoD3Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows executable imports own disc image Limits: Still in development; upstream describes levels loading/playing and first-level functionality, not Portcove validation. Upstream platforms: Windows executable/setup package and native source build. Exact selected Windows CPU architecture is unknown in frozen README/release research; do not infer it solely from Xbox360 guest CPU. Original data: Own Call of Duty 3 Xbox 360 disc as full XGD1/XGD2/XGD3 or stripped ISO, or an installed folder containing default.xex. Upstream first-start setup extracts it; its published check compares executable size with the compiled target. Exact accepted region, revision and cryptographic executable digest are not established in reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
